Unloading or loading begins on a DOCKED trailer: WAITING to IN_PROGRESS. Refused while the trailer is held (409 `trailer-on-hold`). Where the site yard policy sets `requireSecuringBeforeDoorWork`, an unsecured trailer is refused with 409 `trailer-not-secured` (ADR 0013); with the policy off (the default) nothing changes.
